text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 pager — possible cross-tenant read in Dedicated pool dp-7 (us-east-1). Alerting #incidents.
Alice Nguyen: I'm on pager. brief summary pls?
incident-bot: Observed anomalous GETs from client sessions tied to tenant Asterion (vpc-a-123) returning keys that belong to tenant 'RillTech' — 12 distinct prefix overlaps in last 6m. KV-read counts spike on node gp-07-03.
Ravi Patel: copying logs + commands I'm running. pulling kvcache audit now.
Ravi Patel: ```
$ kvcache-audit --node gp-07-03 --since 2026-03-15T18:00Z --show-prefixes
FOUND 12 cross-read events
prefixs: rill-usr/, rill-kv/meta/, rill-prompt-cache/
sessions: session-44f2, session-998b, session-b23d
```
Maya Lopez: :eyes: this looks like prefix namespace collision. Is dp-7 a shared dedicated pool or per-customer?
Sam Ortega: dp-7 is a reserved pool for Dedicated customers but hosts multiple tenants for smaller entitlements. Asterion recently added new model instances on that pool last week.
Nina Chen: any config changes deployed on routing/orch in the last 24h?
Ravi Patel: checking infra deploys... `deploy-tracker` shows a config push 2026-03-15T16:50 from eng-runtime: route-migration v2.4 to dp-7. I'm rolling a read-only snapshot for forensic.
Priya Singh: cc @account-ops and CS for customer impact comms? Liam, can you patch Asterion?
Liam O'Connor: pinged Asterion via acct-ops. They report a single customer API call that returned unexpected items and they've paused traffic. They asked for ETA.
Alice Nguyen: immediate goal: stop any further cross-tenant reads, preserve evidence, and assess scope. Options: 1) Quarantine dp-7 (evict non-critical tenants) 2) Disable prefix-based KV caching globally 3) Roll back routing config v2.4. Thoughts?
Maya Lopez: prioritize isolation with minimal customer disruption. Eviction + redirect of evicted tenants to fallback pool is preferred. But rolling back routing may be faster if safe.
Ravi Patel: rollback attempt may be risky for in-flight sessions. Quarantine path: mark dp-7 maintenance, spin up ephemeral pool dp-7q, move trusted tenants (Asterion + RillTech?) Wait RillTech is affected; we should move the impacted tenant out and keep them isolated.
Sam Ortega: we should not move Asterion off the pool until we confirm they didn't read other tenants; better isolate the node gp-07-03 and fail traffic off that node.
Nina Chen: if gp-07-03 is the hotspot, we can cordon it: `orch cordon-node gp-07-03` and drain. That should stop further cross-reads quickly.
Ravi Patel: executing cordon now.
Ravi Patel: ```
$ orch cordon-node gp-07-03 --reason "suspected cross-tenant read"
Node gp-07-03 marked cordoned. Draining sessions...
Evicted 48 sessions, 4 reconnected to other nodes, 44 terminated.
```
Alice Nguyen: good. Is there evidence those evicted sessions caused exposures beyond the logged 12 events?
Ravi Patel: initial scan of audit log shows 12 confirmed reads. I'm expanding window to 24h to be safe.
Maya Lopez: set retention for forensic logs to high and snapshot KV store. We need to provide artifacts to security and to the customer.
Ravi Patel: snapshot started: `kvsnapshot create --pool dp-7 --out s3://forensics/3033334444-dp7-snap.tar.gz`
Priya Singh: Created incident ticket INC-2026-8342 and added customer impact notes. Tagging legal and compliance for data exposure review.
Liam O'Connor: Customer-facing note: "We've detected anomalous reads within a shared dedicated pool and are performing isolation and forensic steps. No PII confirmed yet. We're pausing your traffic temporarily and will update within 2 hours." Want me to send?
Alice Nguyen: yes, send that with ETA 2 hours and offer a conference call if they want. Keep wording careful: avoid admitting data exfiltration until we confirm.
Nina Chen: collecting command timeline and hash of snapshots. Also collecting kernel logs from gp-07-03.
Ravi Patel: expanding audit window done. Additional 3 potential reads found at T-3h; session IDs different, investigating correlation.
Maya Lopez: adding hypothesis: routing table applied wrong prefix normalization in route-migration v2.4 causing overlapping prefix namespace between tenants with similar prefixes. Need to validate normalization codepath.
Nina Chen: looking at router config: our prefix canonicalization uses `strip-suffix` heuristic. There's a bug where trailing slash removal collapses `rill-kv/` and `rill-kv` into same canonical — intended — but the bug treats `rill-kv/meta/` as `rill-kv` for routing keys. Patch incoming.
Sam Ortega: can we hotfix the canonicalization function and redeploy only to dp-7?
Ravi Patel: I can build a narrow hotfix and apply to routing agents on dp-7. But deploy needs coordination; will cause short reconnects. Estimate 8-12m.
Alice Nguyen: approved. Nina, Maya, Ravi — you own the hotfix. Sam, coordinate evicted tenants and fallback mapping. Priya, update INC ticket + PD. Liam, prep customer comms with CS.
Ravi Patel: starting hotfix branch and CI. Will try to do canary on gp-07-04 first.
Ravi Patel: ```
# patch: ensure full-prefix match for routing key
- normalize_prefix(p): return p.rstrip('/')
+ normalize_prefix(p): return p if p.endswith('/') else p + '/'
```
Ravi Patel: canary deploy to gp-07-04 started. Monitoring KV reads.
Priya Singh: PD alert annotated: mitigation in progress. Noted CS update scheduled at +30m.
Maya Lopez: watch for regressions in latency; canary might break some clients relying on old behavior.
Ravi Patel: canary looks clean for 6m. No cross-reads on canary node. Proceeding to roll dp-7 routing agents (batch size 2).
Alice Nguyen: rolling now. Keep logs. Set rollback point.
Ravi Patel: rollout complete across routing agents for dp-7. Observability: cross-read count back to 0 in 5m window.
Nina Chen: snapshot hash: sha256: 3f4b2a9... stored at s3://forensics/3033334444-dp7-snap.tar.gz. Forensic package attached to INC-2026-8342.
Liam O'Connor: Customer update: sent initial note and offered 1:1. They responded 'thank you, please confirm when safe to resume traffic'.
Alice Nguyen: recommended next step: keep Asterion paused until we complete 24h audit and confirm no PII exposure. Offer to resume to a dedicated single-tenant pool if they want faster recovery.
Liam O'Connor: customer prefers dedicated single-tenant move. Initiating migration plan with SE.
Nina Chen: postmortem items (initial): - root cause: prefix canonicalization bug in route-migration v2.4 - mitigation: cordoned node, hotfix, routing agent roll - remediation: add unit tests for prefix normalization, pre-deploy canary gate, stronger KV-access assertions - communication: customer, legal, SEC notified.
Priya Singh: timeline and owners added to INC ticket. Scheduled follow-up incident review tomorrow 11am.
Maya Lopez: legal requested list of keys potentially exposed for review. We'll deliver list under NDA handling.
Alice Nguyen: great job team. Keep updates in thread. If new anomalies pop, escalate to Sev1.
Ravi Patel: final check: extending audit window to 72h overnight. Will post summary in 2h.
incident-bot: Pager status: mitigation_in_progress -> partial_mitigated. PD incident updated.
Alice Nguyen: closing active paging rotation. Oncall remains monitoring for 2h then handback to next oncall.
Liam O'Connor: will follow up with customer and schedule migration.
Priya Singh: filing retrospective doc and action items. Thanks everyone :heart:
